name: @ostomy/core
description: Shared kernel: two-tier validation, canonical unit conversion, Daily Net Fluid Balance classification, and the i18n catalog. Consumed by apps/api and both patient clients (ADR-0007).
//exports: No root '.' export on purpose (ADR-0007): validation, units, hydration and i18n came from P1.S4, and ./sync from P2.S0 — five owned, independent entry points, each with exactly one authoring agent. fhir-data-modeler adds ./fhir when its sprint lands; ./api-client is generated. A root barrel is deliberately not introduced — see packages/config/eslint/index.js's admin-boundary comment on why an all-encompassing '@ostomy/core' specifier is exactly the thing to avoid reintroducing casually.
